She stopped now to speak to Mrs Ashley, the woman at the Lodge; and the children pressed a little nearer, and Ralph touched Rose, and Rose nodded to Susie, and all three gazed at Edward with the same question on each pair of lips and in each pair of eyes.

arxiv-2005-14605.title: CoolMomentum: A Method for Stochastic Optimization by Langevin Dynamics with Simulated Annealing This is a post-peer-review, precopyedit version of an article published in Scientific Reports . The final authenticated version is available online at: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-021-90144-3
arxiv-2005-14605.creator: Oleksandr Borysenko, Maksym Byshkin
arxiv-2005-14605.description: Abstract Deep learning applications require global optimization of non-convex objective functions, which have multiple local minima. The same problem is often found in physical simulations and may be resolved by the methods of Langevin dynamics with Simulated Annealing, which is a well-established approach for minimization of many-particle potentials. This analogy provides useful insights for non-convex stochastic optimization in machine learning.

arxiv-2107-09374.title: Klein paradox for bosons, wave packets and negative tunnelling times
arxiv-2107-09374.creator: X. Gutiérrez de la Cal a, M. Alkhateeb b, M. Pons c, A. Matzkin b, D. Sokolovski a,d∗
arxiv-2107-09374.description: Abstract We analyse a little known aspect of the Klein paradox. A Klein-Gordon boson appears to be able to cross a supercritical rectangular barrier without being reflected, while spending there a negative amount of time. The transmission mechanism is demonstrably acausal, yet an attempt to construct the corresponding causal solution of the Klein-Gordon equation fails.

arxiv-2111-01469.title: 7 Be in the outburst of the ONe nova V6595 Sgr 7 Be in the outburst of the ONe nova V6595 Sgr – 2002
arxiv-2111-01469.creator: Molaro, P, Izzo, L, D’Odorico, V, Aydi, E, Bonifacio, P, Cescutti, G. Harvey, E.J, Hernanz, M, Selvelli, P, della Valle, M
arxiv-2111-01469.description: Abstract We report the search for 7 Be ii isotope in the outbursts of the classical nova V6595 Sgr by means of high resolution UVES observations taken at the ESO VLT in April 2021, about two weeks after discovery and under difficult circumstances due to the pandemic.

arxiv-2305-14530.title: Cusp singularities in the distribution of orientations of asymmetrically-pivoted hard discs on a lattice
arxiv-2305-14530.creator: Sushant Saryal, Deepak Dhar
arxiv-2305-14530.description: Abstract We study a system of equal-sized circular discs each with an asymmetrically placed pivot at a fixed distance from the center. The pivots are fixed at the vertices of a regular triangular lattice. The discs can rotate freely about the pivots, with the constraint that no discs can overlap with each other.

arxiv-2308-03773.title: Goodness-of-Fit of Attributed Probabilistic Graph Generative Models Conference: ACM Conference; March 2023; Singapore Price: 15.00 ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06 CCS: Theory of computation Random network models
arxiv-2308-03773.creator: Pablo Robles-Granda, Katherine Tsai, Oluwasanmi Koyejo
arxiv-2308-03773.description: Abstract . Probabilistic generative models of graphs are important tools that enable representation and sampling. Many recent works have created probabilistic models of graphs that are capable of representing not only entity interactions but also their attributes. However, given a generative model of random attributed graph(s), the general conditions that establish goodness of fit are not clear a-priori.

arxiv-2309-08539.title: On the size of Bruhat intervals
arxiv-2309-08539.creator: Federico Castillo, Damian de la Fuente, Nicolas Libedinsky and David Plaza
arxiv-2309-08539.description: Abstract For affine Weyl groups and elements associated to dominant coweights, we present a convex geometry formula for the size of the corresponding lower Bruhat intervals. Extensive computer calculations for these groups have led us to believe that a similar formula exists for all lower Bruhat intervals. 1 Introduction 1.

arxiv-2312-05738.title: FedReverse: Multiparty Reversible Deep Neural Network Watermarking
arxiv-2312-05738.creator: Junlong Mao, Huiyi Tang, Yi Zhang, Fengxia Liu, Zhiyong Zheng, Shanxiang Lyu
arxiv-2312-05738.description: Abstract The proliferation of Deep Neural Networks (DNN) in commercial applications is expanding rapidly. Simultaneously, the increasing complexity and cost of training DNN models have intensified the urgency surrounding the protection of intellectual property associated with these trained models. In this regard, DNN watermarking has emerged as a crucial safeguarding technique.

arxiv-2403-04039.title: Sample size planning for conditional counterfactual mean estimation with a K-armed randomized experiment
arxiv-2403-04039.creator: Gabriel Ruiz
arxiv-2403-04039.description: Abstract We cover how to determine a sufficiently large sample size for a K K -armed randomized experiment in order to estimate conditional counterfactual expectations in data-driven subgroups. The sub-groups can be output by any feature space partitioning algorithm, including as defined by binning users having similar predictive scores or as defined by a learned policy tree.

arxiv-2403-13949.title: Emission of fast-propagating spin waves by an antiferromagnetic domain wall driven by spin current
arxiv-2403-13949.creator: Roman V. Ovcharov, B.A. Ivanov, Johan Åkerman, Roman S. Khymyn
arxiv-2403-13949.description: Abstract Antiferromagnets (AFMs) have great benefits for spintronic applications such as high frequencies (up to THz), high speeds (up to tens of km/s) of magnetic excitations, and field-free operation. Advanced devices will require high-speed propagating spin waves (SWs) as signal carriers, i.e., SWs with high k-vectors, the excitation of which remains challenging.

arxiv-2406-11915.title: miniCodeProps: a Minimal Benchmark for Proving Code Properties
arxiv-2406-11915.creator: Evan Lohn, Sean Welleck
arxiv-2406-11915.description: Abstract AI agents have shown initial promise in automating mathematical theorem proving in proof assistants such as Lean. The same proof assistants can be used to verify the correctness of code by pairing code with specifications and proofs that the specifications hold.

arxiv-2410-13956.title: Benchmarking Transcriptomics Foundation Models for Perturbation Analysis : one PCA still rules them all
arxiv-2410-13956.creator: Ihab Bendidi, Shawn Whitfield, Kian Kenyon-Dean, Hanene Ben Yedder, Yassir El Mesbahi, Emmanuel Noutahi, Alisandra K. Denton
arxiv-2410-13956.description: Abstract Understanding the relationships among genes, compounds, and their interactions in living organisms remains limited due to technological constraints and the complexity of biological data. Deep learning has shown promise in exploring these relationships using various data types. However, transcriptomics, which provides detailed insights into cellular states, is still underused due to its high noise levels and limited data availability.

arxiv-2507-00625.title: Modulator-free transmitter for quantum key distribution in metropolitan area networks
arxiv-2507-00625.creator: Roman Shakhovoy, Evgeniy Dedkov, Igor Kudryashov
arxiv-2507-00625.description: Abstract A positive economic effect from the implementation of quantum key distribution (QKD) technology can be achieved only with significant scaling, which involves the deployment of branched metropolitan area networks. The creation of QKD systems suitable for such networks is an important task for the coming years.

pmc-10594423.creator: Jovica Saponjski, Ljudmila Stojanovich, Natasa Stanisavljevic, Aleksandra Djokovic, Radisa Vojinovic, Svetlana Kocic, Simon Nikolic, Predrag Matic, Branka Filipovic, Vuk Djulejic, Vladan Colovic, Nikola Bogosavljevic, Dejan Aleksandric, Dejan Kostic, Biljana Brkic Georgijevski, Miroslav Misovic, Nik
pmc-10594423.description: Introduction: Antiphospholipid syndrome (APS) is an autoimmune disease characterised by arterious and venous thrombosis, miscarriage, and the presence of antiphospholipid antibodies (aPL) in the blood. As we know, APS is also characterised by accelerated atherosclerotic degeneration with an increased risk of thrombosis in all blood vessels, including the carotid arteries. Carotid artery stenosis can manifest in many different ways.

pmc-11711175.title: Perioperative complications in patients aged ≥85 years undergoing spinal surgery: a retrospective comparative study of pre-old and old patients in Japan

pmc-11725132.creator: Hui Xu, Hong-Li Tan, Hua-Jun Wang, Xiao-Fei Zheng, Yan-Ping Wu, Rong-Rong He

pmc-12491278.title: Stigma and social withdrawal among colorectal cancer survivors with permanent stomas: the mediating role of social motivation in psychosocial adaptation
pmc-12491278.creator: Qi Yao, Guopeng Li, Zhaolun Dong, Kai Liu, Xiaoling Dong
pmc-12491278.description: PurposeSocial withdrawal is common among colorectal cancer (CRC) survivors with permanent stomas, and stigma can play an important role in the development of social withdrawal. However, the underlying psychological mechanisms are understudied. The current study examined the associations of stigma with social motivation, and social withdrawal among CRC survivors with permanent stomas.

pmc-12584370.title: Deciphering mismatch repair protein expression variability in gastric cancer: clinical and prognostic implications
pmc-12584370.creator: Fengmei Zhong, Mengjia Zhang, Like Xu, Jinlong Cui, Zhen Chen, Qiqi Gao
pmc-12584370.description: BackgroundGastric cancer (GC) exhibits diverse molecular characteristics, among which microsatellite instability (MSI) plays a pivotal role in determining treatment responses, particularly to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs). Mismatch repair (MMR) protein immunohistochemical (IHC) staining is a primary screening method for MSI; however, heterogeneity in staining patterns can complicate interpretation.

pmc-13209351.title: Experiences of Ex-Smokers Serving as Peer Supporters in an Instant Messaging-Based Smoking Cessation Program: A Qualitative Study
pmc-13209351.creator: Ziqiu Guo, Tzu Tsun Luk, Xue Weng, Jung Jae Lee, Yongda Wu, Shengzhi Zhao, Derek Yee Tak Cheung, Agnes Yuen Kwan Lai, Henry Sau Chai Tong, Vienna Wai Yin Lai, Tai Hing Lam, Man Ping Wang
pmc-13209351.description: Objectives: To explore the experiences of ex-smokers acting as peer supporters delivering chat-based instant messaging smoking cessation support in a post- randomized controlled trial qualitative study. Methods: We used purposive sampling to recruit 21 ex-smokers, who had previously provided chat-based instant messaging behavioral support to smokers in Hong Kong. Individual online semi-structured interviews were conducted.

pmc-13456678.title: Efficacy of Liuzijue in Improving Respiratory Muscle Dysfunction in Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease: Protocol for a Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13456678.creator: Yiting Ni, Wei Feng, Wangtao Cai, Yuxin Sun, Min Cao, Juhan Chen, Jian Li
pmc-13456678.description: BackgroundChronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a prevalent chronic lung disease, and respiratory muscle dysfunction is one of its key pathogenic mechanisms. Liuzijue, a traditional Chinese health exercise, has been widely applied in COPD rehabilitation, showing benefits in improving pulmonary function and quality of life. However, clinical evidence regarding its specific effects on respiratory muscle function remains insufficient.

pmc-13507051.title: Explainable artificial intelligence reveals key surgical parameters in robot-assisted and open radical prostatectomy
pmc-13507051.creator: Christian R Klein, Pia Heuser, Elena Trunz, Glen Kristiansen, Peter Brossart, Manuel Ritter, Philipp Krausewitz
pmc-13507051.description: Preoperative risk stratification for radical prostatectomy is crucial, yet predicting the wide range of postoperative outcomes remains a significant challenge. While machine learning (ML) shows promise, “black box” models limit clinical translatability. This study aimed to predict postoperative parameters using ML and employ explainable AI (XAI) to identify their key clinical drivers.

pmc-13530277.title: Determinants of tuberculosis infection and disease in paediatric patients in the Czech Republic after tuberculosis exposure
pmc-13530277.creator: Luboš Bača, Martin Magner, Karolína Doležalová
pmc-13530277.description: Background Mycobacterium tuberculosis is a transmissible pathogen most commonly acquired through contact with an infectious individual. Early initiation of tuberculosis (TB) preventive treatment (TPT) in high-risk populations can substantially reduce the risk of TB infection (TBI) and/or progression to active disease.

pmc-13587653.title: To Ask or Not to Ask: Does Inquiring About Participants' Expectations Influence the Placebo Effect? A Placebo Mechanism Study in Healthy Volunteers
pmc-13587653.creator: Sigrid Juhl Lunde, Christina Emborg, Simple Futarmal Kothari, Leslie Foldager, Andrew L Geers, Lene Vase
pmc-13587653.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundExpectations are considered a key mechanism in placebo effects, yet the impact of assessing expectations on placebo responding remains unknown. This placebo mechanism study examined whether assessing participants' expectations influenced placebo effect magnitude.MethodsSixty‐four healthy participants were exposed to individually calibrated heat pain during conditioning with verbal suggestions and during two test conditions: application of an inert cream described as analgesic (placebo) and no cream (no‐treatment).

pmc-13605139.title: Diagnostic Reassessment of a Pulmonary Mass Initially Suspected to Represent IgG4-Related Lung Disease: The Complementary Role of Tissue Metagenomic Sequencing
pmc-13605139.creator: So-Yun Kim, Joo-Eun Lee, Da Hye Lee, Hyun-Yi Kim, Kyung-Hee Kim, Hyeongseok Jeong, Chaeuk Chung
pmc-13605139.description: Background/Objectives: Pulmonary mass-like lesions may mimic malignancy, infection, or inflammatory disease, complicating diagnosis when radiologic, histopathologic, and microbiologic findings overlap. This case illustrates the importance of diagnostic reassessment when the clinical course and treatment response are not fully consistent with the initial diagnosis.
